Name: Green Apple Cursor
Author: lezixixixixi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size][color=#999999]Replace the default mouse cursor with a fresh green apple shape, adding a touch of cute and lively vibe to your farm life.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download the mod and put the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Simple and clean green apple cursor design, High visibility on all game screens
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 3.0 or above
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for all the tutorials and support.
